headline: Nothing without Trump! Power line between Romania and Moldova will bear the name of the US president
summary: The high-voltage line connecting Romania and the Republic of Moldova will be named the Trump Liberty Line, according to an announcement by the US Embassy in Chișinău. The project will link the two countries' power grids.
why: Cross-border power interconnections improve electricity supply security and trade between neighbouring grids, which matters for energy infrastructure investors in the region.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude
